subject: GreenFlow RFP: inference benchmark credits request
messages:
From: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@greenflow.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@greenflow.io>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: GreenFlow RFP: inference benchmark credits request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We just kicked off the vendor RFP for our real-time inference layer and are planning a two-week side-by-side benchmark against two vendors (you + CompetitorX). I attached the RFP and the test cases we will run.

Ask: can Redwood provide evaluation credits we can use to run the benchmark (GPU-backed inference, standard LLM workflows + streaming)? Ideally we’d get an allocation we can run across multiple users and runs; ballpark we expect ~500k tokens but that can vary by model.

Timeline: we need the tests available by next Tuesday (2026-09-07) so results are included in our evaluation window.

Other asks: a quick note on any throughput/latency SLOs you can commit for the evaluation, and whether you can share a short SOC2 snapshot or security contacts for procurement. Procurement is cc’d.

Attachments: [GreenFlow_RFP_v2.pdf (pdf), GreenFlow_Test_Cases.xlsx (xlsx)]

Appreciate it—if this is something you can support, we’ll also consider a short co-marketing case study if the results are compelling.

Best,
Emma Taylor
VP Product, GreenFlow Energy
emma.taylor@greenflow.io
phone: +1 415-555-0192
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Taylor <emma.taylor@greenflow.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: GreenFlow RFP: inference benchmark credits request

Emma—thanks for sending, and for including the test cases. I took a quick look; workflows look straightforward.

Short answers up front: yes, we can support a benchmark allocation and we can provide a SOC2 snapshot for procurement. We’ll need to agree on the scope (target models, concurrency, and whether you want streaming enabled) to size the credit and attach appropriate throughput targets.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm which model families you want us to run against (open models or a Redwood-curated variant)?
- If 500k tokens is the estimate, we can provision a $3k–$4k evaluation credit to cover GPU-backed runs and repeated ramp tests.
- I’m looping in Marissa (sales lead) and Karthik (solutions) to coordinate the approval and technical setup.

If that range sounds OK I’ll request the formal promo approval and generate the trial plan + HubSpot record. I can also schedule a short kickoff call this week if you want.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Jonas / Karthik — quick internal note.

Reviewed Emma’s RFP and the ask. Given GreenFlow is a mid-market energy tech prospect with strong expansion potential (regional footprint + platform integration), I’m comfortable approving an evaluation incentive. Approvals:

- Grant up to $4,000 in evaluation credits (covers ~500k–700k tokens for GPU-backed tests and test ramping).
- Extend trial window to 45 days from provisioning to allow for repeated runs.
- Condition: request a 30-minute post-run readout and permission to anonymize a one-paragraph case note if results are positive.

Please document the credit as a promo in HubSpot (link below) and set an internal expiry (60 days from issuance) in case procurement stalls. Also attach SOC2 snapshot to procurement thread.

I’m copying the SOC2 snapshot in case procurement asks for evidence.
